## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Antalya, Turkey. It starts at Kadriye Mahallesi Atatürk Caddesi No:1, D:No 515, Serik.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> There are theme parks, and then there's the Land of Legends. Think bigger, better and wetter! From its gargantuan roller coasters to the monumental Legends Tower, entering Turkey's 800,000-square-meter theme park is like stepping into another world.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €56.25. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 146 ratings and 65 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
